chapter.verse: Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu a nungzuite tawh Kidron Luikuam galkhat ah paikhia hi. Tua takah huan khat om a, tua sungah Jesu leh a nungzuite lut uh hi.
Tua mun ah Jesu a nungzuite tawh kimukhawm thei zelzel ahih manin amah a lehhek Judas in zong tua mun theitel hi.
Tua ahih manin Judas in galkap thuangpi khat banah siampi liante leh Pharisee-te' sawl zum nasem kimkhat va ngahkhia a, amaute tawh meivak, meitawn leh hiamte tawi-in tua mun ah pai hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in ama' tunga piang ding khempeuh thei ahih manin amaute' kiangah pai a, “Kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Amaute in, “Nazareth khuami Jesu,” ci uh hi. Jesu in, “Kei amah ka hi hi,” ci hi. Amah a lehhekpa Judas zong tua mite tawh dingkhawm hi.
“Kei amah ka hi hi,” ci-in Jesu in a dawn ciangin amaute nungkinin lei ah puk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in dong leuleu hi. Amaute in, “Nazareth khuami Jesu,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Kei amah ka hi hi, kong ci khin hi. Tua hi a, kei hong zong na hih uhleh hih mite ciahsak lel un,” ci hi.
Hih pen ama' gensa ahi, “Kei' tunga nong ap mite, khat zong ka mansuah kei hi,” a cih thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Simon Peter in a namsau kuah dokin siampi lianpenpa' silapa a sat leh a taklam bil satkhiakha hi. (Tua silapa' min Malchus ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Jesu in Peter' kiangah, “Na namsau a paai ah siatkik in. Pa' hong piak hai dawn lo-in om ding ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkap tul-uk mangpa, a galkapte, leh Jew makaite' zum nasemte in Jesu manin hen uh hi.
A masa-in Annas' kiangah paipih uh hi. A hang pen tua kuma siampi lianpenpa a sem Caiaphas ii sungpa ahih man hi.
Caiaphas cih pen mipite' taangin mi khat a sih ding hoihzaw ci-in Jew makaite a kuppihpa ahi hi.
Simon Peter in Jesu zui a, nungzui a dang khat in zong zui hi. Tua nungzuipa pen siampi lianpenpa tawh kimeltheih ahih manin siampi lianpenpa' zum inntual sungah Jesu tawh lut hi.
Peter ahihleh huang pualam kongpi gei ah ding hi. Tua hangin siampi lianpenpa tawh a kimeltheih nungzuipa hong pusuak a, kongcingnu hopihin Peter tumpih hi.
Kongcingnu in Peter' kiangah, “Nang zong hih mipa' nungzuite khat hilo na hi hiam?” ci ahih manin Peter in, “Ka hikei hi,” ci hi.
(Tu-in khuadam ahih manin silate leh zum nasemte in meihol tawh meicih uh a, dinsa-in mei-awi uh hi. Peter zong amaute' lakah dinsa-in mei-awi hi.)
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in Jesu' kiangah a nungzuite leh a hilhcianna vaite dong hi.
Jesu in, “Leitung ah a langtangin ka gen khinzo hi. Jew mite' kikaihkhopna vengkhawm innte leh biakinnpi ah thu ka hilh den a, a simthamin ka gen khat zong om lo hi.
Bang hangin kei hong dong na hi uh hiam? Ka thugen a za khinsa mite dong un. Amaute in ka thugen thei uh hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute a gen khit ciangin a gei-a ding zum nasemte khat in, “Siampi lianpenpa na dawnkikzia tu-a dan ahi hiam?” ci-in a khut tawh Jesu paangbet hi.
Jesu in, “Ka thugen a khialh leh a khialhna teci lak inla, ahi zongin ka thugen maan ahihleh bang hangin hong paangbet na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Annas in Jesu a kihensa mahin siampi lianpenpa Caiaphas' kiangah puak hi.
Tu-in Simon Peter pen ding kawmin mei-awi hi. Tua ciangin mite in, “Nang zong ama' nungzuite khat hilo na hi hiam?” ci uh hi. Peter in, “Ka hikei hi,” ci-in nial hi.
A bil Peter' satkhiatsakpa tawh a kitanau, siampi lianpenpa' zum nasemte khat in, “Huan ah nang hong mu hilo ka hi hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Peter in nial leuleu a, tua lianleh ak khuang hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in Caiaphas' inn pan gam-uk mangpa' mang innpi ah Jesu paikhiatpih uh hi. (A hun pen zingsang tuung ahi hi). Jew mite pen amaute a thanghuai suak lo-in Paisan Pawi an a nek theih nadingun gam-uk mangpa' innhuang sung lut lo uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute' kiangah Pilate hong pusuakkhia a, “Hih mipa' tungah bang thu ngawh na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Thusia semlo hileh nang' kiangah kong ap kei ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Pilate in, “Amah paikhiatpih unla nomau' thukhun tawh thukhenna na bawl un,” ci hi. Jew mite in, “Mi khatpeuh sihna ka tut ding uh phaltheih thu hilo hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih pen ama' sih dingzia Jesu' gen thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.
Tua hangin mang innpi sungah Pilate lutkikin Jesu sam a, “Nang Jew Kumpi na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Hih pen nang' thu-a nong dot ahi hiam? Ahihkeileh keima' thu midangte in hong gen khin uh ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Pilate in, “Kei Jew hi zenzen ka hi hiam? Na mipihte leh na siampi liante in kei' kiangah nang hong ap uh hi. Bang semkha na hi hiam?” ci hi.

Jesu in, “Keima' kumpigam pen hih leitung pan hilo hi. Hi hileh Jew mite' kiangah kei hong ki-ap loh nadingin ka nasemte hong kitom ding uh hi. Ahi zongin keima' kumpigam pen leitung pan hilo hi,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin Pilate in, “Tua bang ahihleh kumpi na hi hi!” ci hi. Jesu in, “Kumpi na hi nong ci hi. Hih thu hang mahin kei ka suak a, hih thu hang mahin—thumaan thutak a pulak dingin—leitung kong pai hi. Thumaan thutak lama om mi peuhmah in keima' aw hong ngai uh hi,” ci hi.
Pilate in, “Thumaan thutak na cih bang ahi hiam?” ci hi. Tua a cih khit ciangin a pualam-a om Jew mite' kiangah paikik a, “Ama' tungah khialhna ka mu kei hi.
Ahi zongin Paisan Pawi hun simin note' ading mi khat kong khahkhiat ding ngeina khat na nei uh hi. Tua ahih manin note' kiangah Jew Kumpi kong khahkhiat ding na deih uh hiam?” ci hi.
Amaute awng leuleu uh a, “Hih mipa deih lo, Barabbas hizaw hen!” ci uh hi. (Barabbas a cih pen kumpi lehdo khat ahi hi.)
